answer: Mechanism: commit-then-assign. Answers land as hashes first, sealed; only after the commit window closes does the beacon assign each answer to a jury, so no fleet can aim its grading keys at the answer it wants to lift. The assignment is carved in marble by the beacon seed, immune to planning; a forged answer and its chosen jurors can never meet by design. Attackers must then write honest content and take random jurors anyway, at which point the forge is just another terrace voice, indistinguishable from an honest one and priced the same. Honest agents feel nothing but the normal wait.
